In [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]], the [[Krish (species)/Legends|Krish]] [[Gamgalon]] established a '''safari''' to hunt [[Morodin/Legends|Morodins]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Varonat/Legends|Varonat]]. The operation was shut down a [[8 ABY/Legends|year later]] by [[Talon Karrde]] after he discovered the Morodins were [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]].
